report_text: Employee was working on 480V pump motor when electrical disconnect arc flashed. Employee suffered 2nd degree burns to hands and face.
Employee was guiding a joint of drill pipe being lifted by the rig catline when the wire rope parted. The pipe dropped striking employee on left leg.
Employee was using cutting torch to remove bolts on crude unit piping. Residual vapors inside pipe ignited causing flash fire.
Employee entered condensate storage tank through manway to clean bottom sludge. Employee was overcome by hydrocarbon vapors and oxygen deficiency.
Excavator struck 12-inch crude transmission pipeline while trenching for drainage line. Line ruptured releasing 45 bbls of oil.
Transport tanker driver was backing into loading rack when vehicle struck concrete safety bollard. Driver suffered neck strain.
Floorhand was latching rotary tongs on drill string. Tongs snapped back under torque pinching right hand against drill pipe.
Technician bypassed high-pressure safety switch on compressor to troubleshoot alarm. Overpressure caused relief valve to pop violently.
Scaffold worker fell 18 feet from temporary pipe rack staging when walking plank slipped. Employee sustained fractured pelvis.
Mechanic unbolted valve flange on pressurized natural gas line without bleeding trapped pressure. High pressure gas blew gasket into employee.
During hydrostatic pressure testing at 1200 PSI, blind flange gasket failed catastrophically spraying water and debris at test crew.
Welder was grinding on fuel loading arm without covering adjacent drain. Sparks ignited residual diesel in drain pan.
Crane hoisting casing pipe swung unexpectedly in wind. Casing struck floorhand on rig floor causing broken collarbone.
Contractor entered boiler firebox for refractory inspection without continuous gas monitor. Atmosphere became deficient in oxygen.
Contractor started hydroblasting exchanger tubes at 10000 PSI before operations signed off on lock out tag out permit.
High pressure hydraulic line on compressor valve actuator burst under 2000 PSI pressure. Hydraulic fluid injected into worker forearm.
Worker was inside 7-foot deep un-shored pipeline excavation when sidewall collapsed, burying worker to waist level.
Fuel truck rollover on icy terminal access road due to driver operating at unsafe speed for weather conditions.
Derrickhand unclipped harness lanyard to cross derrick board at 85 feet elevation and slipped on drilling mud.
Electrician opened 4160V switchgear cubicle for breaker service without verifying bus de-energization with high-voltage probe.
Hot work permit issued without gas testing inside adjacent closed sewer. Welding sparks ignited sewer gas causing manhole cover blowout.
Operator pinned down ESD valve handle with steel rod to avoid plant shutdown during liquid level surge in scrubber.
Nylon rigging sling parted while lifting 4-ton mainline pump motor. Motor fell 4 feet onto concrete foundation pad.
Tank cleaning crew entered gasoline storage tank with breathing airline hose pinched, reducing air supply to entry worker.
Mud pump discharge line relief pin sheared under 3000 PSI pressure spike. Metal pin fragment struck floorhand in leg.
Night crew began welding on crude header using day shift hot work permit that expired at 1700 hours.
Painter stepped onto fiberglass skylight panel on compressor building roof. Panel broke and employee fell 22 feet to concrete floor.
Pipefitter loosened flange bolts on propane line assuming block valve held. Trapped liquid propane flashed to vapor causing severe freeze burns.
Utility pickup truck collided with pipeline right-of-way marker while driver was checking navigation device.
Contractor was grinding structural steel 10 feet from fuel loading rack while tanker loading was in progress.
Air winch line fouled on drum and snapped under tension while lifting drill collar into V-door.
Pneumatic impact gun socket flew off anvil while torquing flange at 120 PSI shop air pressure.
Worker entered FCC regenerator cyclone without atmospheric test showing oxygen levels. Rescued by standby hole-watch.
Contractor trenching for electrical cable struck 2-inch condensate drain line causing hydrocarbon vapor release.
Technician attempted to replace mechanical seal on crude transfer pump while 600V motor starter was still energized.
Overfill protection sensor probe on loading arm was taped up to prevent automatic shutdown during fast-fill operation.
Roughneck working on stabbing board at 30 feet dropped heavy manual tong die without tool tether.
Welder ignited cutting torch inside lube oil storage bay. Oil soaked rags in corner caught fire.
High pressure waterblast lance nozzle reversed out of heat exchanger tube during cleaning at 12000 PSI, striking operator.
Overhead bridge crane hoist chain bound up on drum and dropped 500kg valve assembly into walkway.
Worker entered valve vault with H2S concentration of 25 PPM without wearing SCBA or personal detector.
Tank truck drove away from loading rack with bottom loading arm still connected, shearing loading arm breakaway coupling.
Mechanic working on mud agitator gearbox was injured when operator turned on agitator from remote console.
Employee fell 12 feet from portable ladder while replacing light ballast in generator room; ladder was unsecured.
Maintenance team unbolted hydrocracker heat exchanger channel head without signed Cold Work Permit.
Nitrogen purge hose at 150 PSI whipped loose from tank connection due to missing safety locking pin in camlock fitting.
Grinding on pipeline casing pipe produced sparks that ignited dead dry grass inside station fence perimeter.
Operator started booster pump while maintenance crew had flange unbolted; isolation valve was not tagged or locked.
Crane load line twisted and dropped top drive sub onto rig floor. No personnel were in the red drop zone.
Two contract laborers entered oily water separator pit without atmospheric testing; oxygen level was 17.2%.
Instrument technician jumped out safety interlock on flare gas compressor to prevent trip during vibration surge.
Excavator backhoe tooth punctured 6-inch sweet gas gathering line during culvert replacement.
Contract insulator fell 15 feet from temporary tube-and-clamp scaffold when midrail gave way under load.
Delivery truck driver struck pipeline overhead gantry due to failure to verify vertical clearance height.
Hydraulic breakout cylinder rod broke under tension while breaking stuck drill string joint, flying across rig floor.
Torch cutting conducted on steel floor grating directly above oily wastewater basin; flash fire occurred.
Electrician shocked by 240V control circuit inside motor control center after main breaker was opened but auxiliary control power remained on.
Contractor entered amine contactor tower without standby attendant present at the manway.
Forklift carrying 2-ton valve tipped forward when traveling on gravel slope with mast fully elevated.
Contract crew began pipeline excavation without obtaining underground utility line locate ticket.
Floorman fell 20 feet from monkey board when safety harness lanyard was connected to unguarded handrail.
High pressure test plug on 4-inch line blew out at 800 PSI striking concrete containment wall.

Mechanic dismantled centrifugal gas compressor seal without locking out suction block valve.
